The three states of matter are solid, liquid and gas.
Which list shows three distinguishing properties of most liquids?
A
fixed shape, easily compressed, lowest density
B
fixed shape, fixed volume, highest density
C
fixed volume, able to flow, easily compressed
D
fixed volume, able to flow, no fixed shape
